question: A block of mass 4 kg is placed on a frictionless horizontal surface and attached to a spring with spring constant 200 N/m. The block is pulled 0.1 m from its equilibrium position and released from rest. What is the maximum speed of the block during its subsequent motion?

Which of the following expressions correctly gives the horizontal acceleration a_w of the wedge while the block slides down?

Which of the following expressions correctly gives the acceleration of the block relative to the ground along the incline (down the slope)?

choices.E: g sin θ - (m/M) g cos θ
